name: Jendersie-d’Eon Phase Function
definition: A phase function model that approximates the true Mie scattering of water droplets. It captures a more realistic forward peak than Henyey-Greenstein.
summary: The Jendersie-d'Eon phase function models Mie scattering for water droplets, offering a sharper forward peak than Henyey-Greenstein for realistic cloud rendering.
